objective: train an independently useful HPA/OpenCell coarse-localization encoder now because Aleph sweeps are not yet computationally feasible, while preserving its later role as a non-authoritative pre-sweep compression layer
final_program_objective_unchanged: after external validation, matched observation operators, identifiability, and Aleph forward sensitivity, use the inferred posterior and ambiguity set to reduce candidate axes and bound an executable Aleph parameter sweep

split_contract.HPA_test_role: already-opened internal diagnostic only; never model selection, calibration, or external authority
split_contract.OpenCell_train_unit: target; 761 targets and at most two nested projections per target
split_contract.OpenCell_selection_unit: target; 157 targets; average projection logits before metrics
split_contract.OpenCell_calibration_unit: target; 199 targets; average projection logits before calibration
split_contract.OpenCell_semantic_OOD_unit: target; 13 targets; average projection embeddings before OOD scoring

architecture.residual_block: two Conv2d(C,C,3,padding=1,bias=false)+GroupNorm(8 or largest divisor <=8)+GELU after first convolution; add identity then GELU
architecture.embedding: Linear(96,64), GELU; L2-normalized copy only for contrastive loss and OOD

optimization.HPA_sampling: seed+epoch permutation; first 2032 of 2037 train components
optimization.OpenCell_sampling: seed+epoch target permutation cycles with replacement to 2032 targets; choose nested projection by salted target occurrence plus epoch modulo available projections
optimization.augmentation: independent uniform rotations in {0,90,180,270} degrees plus independent horizontal and vertical Bernoulli(0.5) flips
optimization.BCE: elementwise BCEWithLogits; positive weight sqrt(provider_train_unit_count/provider_positive_unit_count), negative weight 1; mean within provider then equal mean across providers
optimization.supervised_contrastive: standard temperature-0.1 log-softmax over the 64d L2 embedding; another batch item is positive when multilabel Jaccard >=0.5 and at least one label is shared; anchors without a positive are omitted

selection_contract.OpenCell_projection_aggregation: mean logits per target before sigmoid
selection_contract.provider_supported_class: at least 5 positive and 5 negative selection units in that provider
selection_contract.checkpoint_score: minimum of HPA and OpenCell prevalence_normalized_AP
selection_contract.tie_break: earlier epoch when scores differ by at most minimum_improvement

decision_and_uncertainty_contract.decision_threshold: per class maximize the minimum provider selection F1 among providers with at least 5 positive and 5 negative units; ties choose closest to 0.5 then lower threshold
decision_and_uncertainty_contract.temperature: one scalar fit by equal-provider mean calibration BCE on aggregated HPA and OpenCell calibration units; bounded 0.05 to 20
decision_and_uncertainty_contract.finite_sample_quantile: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))-th order statistic capped at n
decision_and_uncertainty_contract.cross_provider_threshold: maximum eligible provider-specific nonconformity quantile; classes lacking 10 positives in either provider receive no cross-provider calibration authority

OOD_contract.fit_reference: 64d L2-normalized train embeddings, aggregated by development unit
OOD_contract.class_reference: per class centroid and diagonal variance over positive train units pooled across providers; variance floor 1e-6
OOD_contract.score: minimum mean squared standardized distance to any class centroid
OOD_contract.development_endpoint: AUROC comparing OpenCell semantic-OOD targets against OpenCell in-domain selection targets
OOD_contract.external_threshold: 95th percentile of pooled HPA/OpenCell calibration unit scores; diagnostic only until a new independent provider is evaluated

failure_policy.development_gate_failure: freeze the best checkpoint and failure report, keep every new confirmation provider pixel sealed, and grant no production, uncertainty, observable-evidence, or Aleph authority
failure_policy.development_gate_success: freeze checkpoint, thresholds, calibration and OOD reference before preregistering and opening a replacement external provider

authority_contract.independently_useful_current_scope: coarse localization representation and ambiguity-aware observable context
authority_contract.future_sweep_role: pre-sweep posterior and ambiguity-set compression only after the explicit external, observation-operator, identifiability, and forward-sensitivity gates
